title: salvia × palmeri
intro: Salvia × palmeri, commonly known as Palmer's sage, is a hybrid species of sage in the mint family (Lamiaceae), resulting from the cross between Salvia leucophylla and Salvia columbariae. It is used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Salvia × palmeri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as polyphenols, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues, and is also valued for its calming effects on the nervous system.
